description:
`apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/mix/tasks/agent.demo.ex` uses
`Process.put(:__agent_demo_printed, ...)` to track what's been
written to stdout so each MessageUpdate delta is printed exactly
once. Works but leaks global state into the task process.

Fix: thread the printed-so-far string through `loop_until_end/1`'s
recursion instead. One extra parameter; no dict.
title: Remove Process dict hack from mix agent.demo
